details: Original host-policy/signature finding is unsupported by the checked dates and Git signature. Keep inconclusive: full prose/graph acceptance and signing-key identity remain unverified.
evidence_ref: Live Antonina board issue 231 from antonina board show --id 231 --page 1 --json: description requires non-main human-review branch, says no merge without human review; comments show implementation completion at 2026-10-09T18:17:36Z and scheduler turns through 2026-10-11T06:05:37Z, no exact Vitalik author, no billy-dev host. Founder host directive effective 2026-10-29; thus events predate it. Independent bounded clone /tmp/opencode/vau231-audit: git ls-remote confirms refs/heads/impl/231-maxwells-demon=c6060d1948ebe09e564a8612f54410aa063e8d72; b523d83cb799c6e364134f2880abd8e20e9d01f1 is ancestor; git verify-commit reports Good signature from Otto Jung, EDDSA key 08AF2726387BD4A4C87DF1821BEDDF96D7B1BA2B (key trust unknown). Commit changes supernatural.md and docs/meaning-graph.md; current master differs, consistent with requested human-review/non-merge state. Full acceptance review and independent key-identity validation not completed.
why_stronger: The original finding treated historical openclaw@marceline-dev comments as a host-policy violation and reported b523d83 as unsigned. A bounded independent clone now verifies b523d83 is an ancestor of the current issue branch and git verify-commit reports a good EdDSA signature; all displayed work comments are dated Oct 9–11, before the Founder Billy-only directive of Oct 29. The issue description requires non-main human review but does not assign billy-dev. These primary Git and timestamped board artifacts materially correct the premises; however the external signing key identity is not independently authenticated and the full acceptance criteria/meaning-graph mapping have not been completely checked, so verified would overclaim. Inconclusive is stronger and narrower than the original finding.
